values.en:
A domain-carrying function `F : PFun` consists of a total map `F.map : ℝ → ℝ` together with a domain `F.domain : Set ℝ`. The total map is defined everywhere as a Lean function, but only its restriction to `F.domain` carries mathematical content. Two PFuns are equal exactly when both components agree.

The point of the bundling is that domains compose. The arithmetic operations intersect domains, so `(F+G).domain = F.domain ∩ G.domain`; division additionally removes the zero set of the denominator; the power operation additionally restricts to where the base is positive. A bare `ℝ → ℝ` cannot express any of this, so those side conditions would have to be re-supplied by hand at every use site.
values.zh-CN:
一个自带定义域的函数 `F : PFun` 由一个全映射 `F.map : ℝ → ℝ` 和一个定义域 `F.domain : Set ℝ` 组成。作为 Lean 函数，该全映射处处有定义，但只有它在 `F.domain` 上的限制才具有数学内容。两个 PFun 相等，恰好当两个分量都相等。

这种捆绑的意义在于定义域可以复合。算术运算取定义域的交，因此 `(F+G).domain = F.domain ∩ G.domain`；除法还要移除分母的零点集；幂运算还要限制在底数为正之处。单独的 `ℝ → ℝ` 无法表达这些内容，因此每次使用时都必须手动重新提供这些附加条件。
